· Position vs SMA100/200 ($84.28/$85.15) — Near the lower bound of the long-term trend.

· RSI Trajectory (38.7→51.5) + Exiting oversold and entering neutral zone + Upward momentum confirmed.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-0.0083→0.0613) + Improvement diagnosed + Bottoming signal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Mid-band $82.51) + Normal band width.

· Swing Resistance ($84.34) + Breakout signifies surpassing 20-day high.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Forming Higher Low) + Recovery trend interpretation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.83x) + Increased confidence in price movement.
· Current Stage Diagnosis (Accumulation) + Buy entry conditions met.
